subject: Site prep checklist, maintenance windows & upgrade coordination for Private (air-gapped) deployment
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@biogenx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Site prep checklist, maintenance windows & upgrade coordination for Private (air-gapped) deployment

Ethan — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so we can move from discovery to an ops-ready plan for your air-gapped appliance deployment.

What I heard
- You want the deployment in BiogenX’s Boston colocation and to keep inference entirely air-gapped.
- Initial footprint: 8x A100-class GPUs, anticipating burst load for weekly batch runs and steady low-latency API traffic.
- Requirements: no external egress from inference nodes; local NFS for logs; site team will manage physical access.

Open items we need to confirm (can you confirm with Nina?):
1) Exact rack power availability per rack (amps / PDU type).
2) Preferred maintenance window cadence (weekly 1–3AM local or monthly scheduled windows?).
3) On-site IP range and whether there is any proxy/bastion requirement.
4) Who will be our primary site contact for crate-unpacking and network handoff (name + cell).

What we’ll provide next
- A simple site-prep checklist (attached) for facilities/ops to validate rack fit, power, and network.
- Hardware/OS image maintenance policy and a proposed upgrade cadence for security patches and runtime updates.
- A list of attachments we’ll ask you to review before scheduling shipment and install.

Proposed next steps
- You confirm the four items above with your site ops (can you loop in Nina?).
- Once we have rack power and contact, we'll run a compatibility check and propose a tentative install date window.
- I’ll loop in Markus (our Deployment Lead) and Monica (Solutions) to align on maintenance SLAs and upgrade windows.

Attachments: site-prep-checklist.xlsx (site checklist), rdw_onprem_hw_requirements_v2.pdf (hw sizing), maintenance-window-template.docx (proposed cadence).

If anything above is off, tell me now and I’ll update. Otherwise, could you reply with Nina’s contact and preferred maintenance cadence by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@biogenx.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@biogenx.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Site prep checklist, maintenance windows & upgrade coordination for Private (air-gapped) deployment

Thanks Lauren — this is great and matches our notes. A few quick answers and clarifications: 

- Rack power: each rack in the Boston colo is rated for two 20A PDUs (208V). I’ll attach the facility rack PDU spec to the ticket.
- Maintenance window: monthly 02:00–04:00 local on the first Sunday is our preferred maintenance slot.
- IP/proxy: we do have an internal egress proxy for systems that require outbound access; however, per our security constraints the inference nodes must not have direct outbound access. Any support packages should be uploaded to a vetted USB or delivered via our secure jump host.
- Primary on-site contact: Nina Patel (nina.patel@biogenx.com, +1-617-555-1133). She’ll handle crate intake and on-site coordination.

I’m CC’ing Nina here to confirm she’s good to be the lead. Nina — can you confirm rack PDU compatibility and whether your facilities team needs a shipping manifest in advance?

Ethan
Senior Cloud Architect
BiogenX

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Site prep checklist, maintenance windows & upgrade coordination for Private (air-gapped) deployment

Folks — forwarding Ethan’s reply. Key bits: Boston colo has two 20A PDUs per rack, monthly first-Sunday 02:00–04:00 for maintenance, and Nina Patel is primary site contact. They flagged no outbound access from inference nodes (uploads via jump host or USB).

Ask: can you confirm we support install under those constraints and whether we need any special packaging or documentation for air-gapped handoff? Also please review the attachments and tell me if anything else is required for compliance signoff.

If it helps, we’ll schedule a quick 30-min sync with Nina to walk through crate arrival and the onsite ethernet handoffs.

Thanks — Lauren

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Site prep checklist, maintenance windows & upgrade coordination for Private (air-gapped) deployment

Lauren / Monica — confirmed, we can operate under the constraints Ethan listed. Notes and immediate asks below: 

1) Power/thermal: two 20A PDUs per rack is fine for the proposed 8x GPU nodes assuming companion PDUs for redundancy. We’ll need the facility PDU pinout and floor plan prior to ship.

2) No outbound: our standard air-gapped install process covers this — we stage OS/firmware images on encrypted NVMe, transfer to the appliance via sealed USBs, and verify checksums on-site. We’ll provide an HSM-backed signing manifest for the images.

3) Maintenance window: monthly first-Sunday 02:00–04:00 works. Important: upgrades that require downtime should be scheduled as a monthly optional block; minor security patches can be pushed to a quarantined node and validated locally without outbound connectivity.

4) Docs / attachments I’m attaching here as stubs: rdw_onprem_hw_requirements_v2.pdf (detailed power/network), site-prep-checklist.xlsx (facilities checklist), maintenance-window-template.docx (upgrade cadence). Also adding a short install-runbook: rdw_airgap_install_runbook.txt.

5) Next operational steps: coordinate a 30-min call with Nina and our PM to confirm crate arrival steps and who signs the manifest. I can do Thu 04/08 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 04/09 08:00–09:00 PT.

Tagging Monica to confirm who from Solutions will attend for configuration review.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Deployment Lead, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
